body:
Let one `add` operation in a design proposal carry an element with its children nested inside it. Any element sent without an id gets a new one from Solace that the design doesn't already use. The design agent's report said hand-writing a large flat list of adds, each with a unique id it made up, was slow and easy to get wrong.

## Done when

- A nested add is stored the same way the separate adds would be (D-230 point 1 child order is kept).
- Elements without ids get unique ones. An id that is supplied and already taken is still refused, naming it.
- The agent can find out which ids were given, so later operations can refer to those elements.
- D-241 point 2 is amended in `DECISIONS.md`, and Spec 15 is updated to match.

## Suggested (cursory, not prescriptive)

- Give out the ids when the proposal is made, so the proposal the human approves is the same one that gets saved. The check from task:08eb320c615ec583 can show them.
title: design: add nested elements, ids given
